title: End-grain wood blocks
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of end-grain wood blocks, as in a butcher block or end-grain parquet: rings around each block's pith, medullary rays, radial checks and glue lines. Use for cutting boards, workbenches and block floors.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python wood_end_grain_blocks.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: blocks_across
parameters.meaning: Blocks across the tile (rows down the tile match, so blocks stay square).

parameters.name: stagger
parameters.meaning: Offset of every other row in block widths (alternation repeats cleanly with an even block count).

parameters.name: ring_density
parameters.meaning: Growth rings per texture unit of radius.

parameters.name: rays
parameters.meaning: Visibility of the radial medullary rays.

parameters.name: checks
parameters.meaning: Radial drying cracks from the pith.

parameters.name: glue_line
parameters.meaning: Width of the glue joints in texture units.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Oiled maple end grain in a straight grid.

presets.name: walnut_staggered
presets.description: Dark walnut blocks with staggered rows and subtle rings.

presets.name: mixed_hardwood
presets.description: Maple, cherry and walnut blocks mixed, oiled.

presets.name: rough_pine
presets.description: Weathered pine log ends with wide rings and deep checks.

limits: Rings are circles around one pith per block with noise, a simplification of real growth. Blocks are square and aligned to the tile. Checks are straight radial cracks. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate.
technique_references: Concentric growth rings around a per-block pith point
Radial medullary rays from the angle around the pith
Per-block hashing for species, tone and pith
Square block grid with an alternate-row offset
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
